decisions.title: Fund credit card paydown
decisions.situation: Card balances, limits, and due dates are being verified. Cards above 30% utilization or without autopay put credit standing at risk.
decisions.rec: Approve funding to bring every revolving card below 30% before its statement closing date, highest-risk cards first.
decisions.required: Approve the paydown total and funding account, or hold until card data is verified.
decisions.next: Kristine completes the card table, then schedules payments after approval.

decisions.title: Turn on autopay for cards without it
decisions.situation: Any card without autopay can miss a due date and trigger a late fee or credit report mark.
decisions.rec: Approve minimum-payment autopay on every card; Kristine pays planned paydowns separately.
decisions.required: Approve autopay setup on all cards listed as Off or Unknown.
decisions.next: Authorized signer enables autopay at each bank; Kristine confirms.

decisions.title: Gonzalo — 460 5th Ave interior balance
decisions.situation: Gonzalo is owed a $2,000 interior balance at 460 5th Ave. Cherry has not yet confirmed the work is complete.
decisions.rec: Keep on hold. Release payment once Cherry confirms completion in writing.
decisions.required: Release the $2,000 or keep it on hold.
decisions.next: Cherry confirms completion; Kristine schedules payment after Juan releases it.

decisions.title: PPS 2025 tax returns — how to file
decisions.situation: Both 2025 returns (IRS Form 1120 and California Form 100) are prepared and checked. PPS lost money in its first year, so $0 is owed.
decisions.rec: File online with TaxAct (~$230). Same $0 tax, but it avoids California’s $100 paper-filing penalty and confirms acceptance in days.
decisions.required: Approve ~$230 for TaxAct, then sign Form 8879-CORP and California Form 8453-C.
decisions.next: Kristine sets line 15a to No, files both returns in TaxAct by Oct 31, and saves the acceptance emails.

decisions.title: Honda Accord lease buyout
decisions.situation: Juan needs to decide whether to buy out the Honda Accord lease. The payoff quote, fees, and deadline are still being confirmed.
decisions.rec: Get the written payoff quote first. Buy out only if the total is at or below the car's market value.
decisions.required: Buy out or return the vehicle, and choose how to pay.
decisions.next: Kristine requests the written payoff quote from the lender.

decisions.title: 8715 D St — collection steps for unpaid rent
decisions.situation: September and October rent for 8715 D St is being checked unit by unit against bank deposits and QuickBooks.
decisions.rec: Approve formal written notices for any unit with unpaid rent, and written payment plans only where the tenant commits to dates.
decisions.required: Approve the collection approach for units with unpaid rent.
decisions.next: Kristine confirms balances per unit; notices go out after approval.

decisions.title: 8715 D St — cover monthly cash shortfall
decisions.situation: If rent collected does not cover the mortgage and expenses, the gap must be funded from another account.
decisions.rec: Fund only the verified shortfall, after this month's rent collections are confirmed.
decisions.required: Approve funding the shortfall and the source account.
decisions.next: Kristine enters mortgage, expenses, and rent received to confirm the gap.

decisions.title: Fixed-rate workers — pay overtime over 40 hours
decisions.situation: Some workers are on a fixed rate meant to cover up to 45 hours, and some work 50+. This is also what blocks exporting Deputy hours straight to Paychex. In California a fixed weekly rate only covers 40 hours.
decisions.rec: Set fixed-rate workers up in Paychex as weekly salary plus overtime from their Deputy hours over 40. That pays overtime correctly and lets everyone go through the export.
decisions.required: Approve the Paychex setup change and a review of overtime owed for past weeks.
decisions.next: Kristine and Marieflor set up the fixed-rate workers in Paychex, then test one week's export.

decisions.title: Matrix Payroll — current period release
decisions.situation: Marieflor prepares payroll from Deputy hours. Kristine checks the data she used and any timesheet changes before release.
decisions.rec: Approve once Kristine confirms the hours match Deputy and every timesheet change has a reason.
decisions.required: Approve payroll release, or hold for discrepancies.
decisions.next: Kristine reviews Marieflor's payroll and the Deputy change history, then confirms the pay date.
